entries.0e7ec5110fd83d5d: It is a mail-order company headquartered in Chuo-ku, Kobe, Hyogo Prefecture. Its de facto business began with Haisensu Co., Ltd., established in 1965, and the current company was established through a new company split in August 2002. It has one consolidated subsidiary, and consolidated employees for the fiscal year ended February 2026 numbered 425.
entries.3ce2572737bf56ce: Mail-order sales of apparel and apparel accessories, such as clothing and personal goods, and the largest product category by sales.
entries.3f5020463d52ce4b: Apparel and apparel accessories (clothing, personal items)
entries.408cf7ec9ee9eace: This is a mail-order company headquartered in Chuo-ku, Kobe, whose business consists of a single segment, the mail-order business.
entries.55c7dd5643e2b29a: This is a mail-order company headquartered in Chuo-ku, Kobe, whose business consists of a single segment, the mail-order business. It has one consolidated subsidiary, and consolidated employees for the fiscal year ended February 2026 numbered 425. Operations from order receipt through customer inquiry handling, information processing, product management and shipment of orders are consolidated and carried out at its own order-receiving and distribution centers.
entries.595b5db9eff43ed8: Household goods (housing goods, daily necessities, beauty and health-related, handicrafts and leisure-related, food)
entries.5cc8cf24afcb31df: It positions the fiscal year ending February 2027 as an important year of execution to realize "normalization of revenue and profit growth," building on the earnings base established in the previous year, and aims to drive its growth trajectory with "fundamental strengthening of the subscription delivery business" and "creation of next-generation businesses" as the two pillars.
entries.7ddb8254d845a978: Segment information, etc. (related information on products and services and information by region), and management's analysis of financial condition, results of operations and cash flows (sales performance)
entries.8b71ac7ce3e2a3d5: Its customers are general consumers in Japan. Online, in addition to selling products, it provides services such as checking delivery status and purchase history, and payment. There is no major customer whose sales account for 10% or more of consolidated net sales.
entries.9b155174e1b6b6c0: The filing suggests that, while sales growth through a recovery in cumulative customer numbers in the subscription delivery business remains an issue for the next fiscal year, the company is evolving the positioning of new business areas, such as B2B and B2G fields and the Kobe Port Tower business, from a "second pillar of earnings" into next-generation businesses that drive medium- to long-term growth, and is pursuing their development through co-creation with external partners.
entries.9cef7927c5399bcf: Net sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥29,179 million, down 0.9% from the previous fiscal year. By product category, apparel and apparel accessories were ¥19,724 million, household goods were ¥6,514 million, and other was ¥2,941 million. While the cumulative number of customers in the subscription delivery business fell below initial expectations, new business areas grew sales.
entries.a49640856538500f: Mail-order sales of lifestyle goods, including housing goods, daily necessities, beauty and health products, crafts and leisure products, and food.
entries.bda05e4dd5a28ade: Mail-order sales of lifestyle goods, including housing goods, daily necessities, beauty and health products, crafts and leisure products, and food. Sales results for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥6,514 million (99.5% of the prior-year period).
entries.c1a73651d77155b6: Sales revenue from product sales by mail order
entries.c48bd0aa23fefede: Mail-order sales of product categories other than those listed above.
entries.ca63d0f83e18e769: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥358 million, up 163.3% from the previous fiscal year. The previous fiscal year's figure was ¥136 million. Improved profitability, from factors including the reorganization of the value chain centered on fashion products, contributed.

Sales results for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥2,941 million (125.0% of the prior-year period).
